summary: ITER105 UI regression completed on frontend build (public URL). Login flow (wait for login-screen to detach) works. Verified: (1) PR create — pr-article-select KNSelect search finds ALICE both by 'ALICE' & '94139'; pr-product-select shows KN color + supplier color + SKU; pr-add-line creates pr-line-dualname-0 row with KN and SUP badges. Supplier dropdown: for ALICE (no contract for that color) shows pr-supplier-none + pr-supplier-show-all; for Benang Katun Cone shows Solo Weave only + pr-supplier-filter-note text 'Hanya supplier yang punya kontrak aktif ... Tampilkan semua'. (2) R&D board rnd-samples has NO col-decided (only draft/sent/in_progress/assessed); rnd-samples-tab-list exists. dsr-board has NO col-approved (only draft/submitted/assigned/in_progress/delivered/revision). (3) Master Products (view=md-products): search ALICE opens family hero with catalog-hero-axis-origin='ASAL Impor', catalog-hero-axis-color='WARNA 10 13 14 8', catalog-hero-axis-grade='GRADE A' (no 'Tidak ada'). Variant labels render as 'Impor · Warna 10 · Grade A' etc. catalog-edit-variant modal shows variant-supplier-alias block with variant-source-name and variant-source-color; supplier-item-color exists in Barang Supplier form (placeholder 'mis. 45 / Navy Dark'). (4) Produk & Harga hub tabs (md-products, md-categories, color-library, md-uoms, pricelist, cs-price-list) all show page-kicker='PRODUK & HARGA' and titles 'Produk & Varian','Kategori Produk','Pustaka Warna','Satuan & Konversi','Harga per Badan Usaha','Harga per Pelanggan'. Search boxes catalog-search paddingLeft=36px, color-search/pl-search/cpl-search paddingLeft=32px (≥28px so magnifier icon doesn't overlap placeholder). pl-filter-override is a checkbox with label 'Hanya yang punya harga khusus'. pl-setprice-* and cpl-setprice-* buttons labeled 'Atur harga' with class 'secondary-button'. Kategori: 'Kategori Baru' form is in narrow left column (does not stretch full). Satuan & Konversi: 'Buat Satuan' is primary-button (blue bg); 'Nonaktifkan' is secondary-button with red text (#C0392B). Product & varian layout width ~1600px (no 1440 cap). (5) Special Orders (view=special-orders): h1='Pesanan Khusus (OD)', tab label 'Dikirim' (not 'Shipped'). Detail: ✨ icon inline with SORD number; od-phases lists Indonesian labels (Draf, Menunggu persetujuan, Disetujui, Sampling berjalan, Sample siap, Menunggu ACC pelanggan, Harga final, Terkonfirmasi, Produksi, Siap, Dikirim, Selesai); od-request-meta shows 'Tipe permintaan: belum ditentukan (OD lama) · Tingkat detail: hanya referensi'. Create modal od-detail-level select renders (not clipped). Approved existing SORD-260618-0001 as admin (via approve-special-order-btn + confirm dialog so-approve-confirm→Setujui) — od-customer-approval and od-pricing panels render but input fields od-price-margin/od-price-note/od-customer-date/od-customer-contact are NOT visible in current state (panels show placeholder 'Menunggu sample winner' & 'Menunggu ACC pelanggan'). CSS class '.input' is properly defined in styles/components.css lines 780+ (border 1px, radius, focus ring) so inputs will render with borders once state activates. (6) Mobile 390px: pricelist and special-orders body.scrollWidth == 390 (no horizontal overflow). Admin session at 390 is redirected to mobile shell as expected.

issues: Tombol 'Nonaktifkan' baris: default border tampil abu-abu (rgb(229,229,234)); border merah tipis (#F5C6C6) hanya muncul saat hover. Spec meminta 'bergaya garis merah tipis (bukan blok merah)' — di state default border belum merah. Minor design nit; teks merah (#C0392B) sudah benar.

Kotak identitas kombinasi masih menampilkan 'Impor · 10 · A · Tidak ada · Tidak ada' (bagian identitas teknis di dalam modal Ubah SKU). Hero page & variant label utama sudah bersih dari 'Tidak ada'; tapi legend identitas di modal masih memuatnya. Bila axis extra memang harus disebut, pertimbangkan menyembunyikan slot kosong seperti di hero.

action_items: (Opsional/minor) Ubah default border tombol Nonaktifkan di md-uoms menjadi merah tipis (#F5C6C6/#E3B7B7) supaya matches spec walau tidak hover.
(Opsional) Sembunyikan 'Tidak ada' di legend identitas kombinasi di modal VariantEditor agar konsisten dengan hero (yang sudah bersih).
critical_code_review_comments: SpecialOrderCustomerApprovalPanel & SpecialOrderPricingPanel input fields (className='input') hanya dirender ketika ada sample winner / setelah sampling ACC. Ini sesuai domain, tapi menyulitkan pengujian testid saat OD baru disetujui. Pertimbangkan menambahkan placeholder minimal / disabled inputs sehingga fields tetap ada di DOM (dengan disabled) — mempermudah smoke test & test UI konsistensi.

PR product select berisi opsi 'header' dengan data-testid='pr-product-select-option-empty' (label: '2. Pilih warna (KN / supplier)'). Playwright bisa keliru meng-klik header (element not enabled). Header sebaiknya bukan <button> (atau tanpa data-testid, atau berikan aria-disabled) — mengurangi bug testing.
Kicker/breadcrumb 'PRODUK & HARGA' saat ini terlihat uppercase karena CSS text-transform. Spec meminta tulisan 'Produk & Harga' — verifikasi apakah styling uppercase memang diinginkan.

Approve SO menggunakan modal-overlay so-approve-confirm namun tombol 'Setujui' di modal tersebut tidak punya data-testid; hanya bisa dipilih via text. Tambahkan data-testid='so-approve-confirm-submit' untuk kestabilan test.
seed_data_creation: Approved existing SORD-260618-0001 (Draf → Menunggu Persetujuan → Terkonfirmasi) to reach od-customer-approval/od-pricing panels. Not TEST_ prefixed data but demo seed. If undesired, re-seed via KNHOST scripts.

To retest .input class border rendering on OD panels, seed an OD with sample winner + R&D closed sampling then verify od-price-margin/od-price-note/od-customer-date/od-customer-contact CSS.
